sessions.notes_text:
Contact Summary: Completed initial Reentry Navigation consultation with Harold Williams to assess his current stability, baseline needs, and establish case plan goals. Client is currently stably housed with his girlfriend and relying on her for transportation, though this is becoming inconvenient due to her work schedule. He recently obtained his learner's permit and will be eligible to take his driver's license test in approximately one month. Client was released on October 1st after serving 17 years and is on state community supervision until September 2028 (in compliance). He is seeking hands-on employment (warehouse, factory, construction) and wishes to avoid fast food/retail. 

Case Plan Goal Progress: Established primary goal of securing full-time employment in a preferred industry. Client has a completed resume and several trade certifications (Brick Masonry, Carpentry, NCCER, WorkKeys, and possibly OSHA) obtained during incarceration. 

Briefcase & Gate 1-4 Updates: Verified possession of Birth Certificate, Social Security Card, State ID, and Resume (Green). Driver's License is in progress (Red/Yellow - has permit, waiting period active). 

Referrals/Resources Provided: Navigator will research and text job postings in the Hartsville and Sumter areas. 

Next Steps: Navigator to send job leads; Client to review leads, apply, and prepare to take his road test next month.
